reason: I would not do the $74 a month membership with two kids on my budget, but $12 for my 4-year-old with the baby free and a coffee included is an okay rainy-day outing. I would try it a couple of times and look at the party price when my birthday planning starts.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and with a crawling baby I'm paying for a break I won't get. $74 a month for both kids is too much when I only go when it's raining.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper multi-visit pass (like 5 visits for around $40) so I don't have to commit to a monthly membership.
